dialogues.speaker: Visitors' Message Board
dialogues.text: "This message board was specially set up here by me, the boss. Visitors, if you have any requirements or queries, feel free to leave them here. Rest assured, I'll take care of them!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "The hot springs are so warm and cozy..."

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "After a good soak in the springs, I felt as light as a dandelion."

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Which got me thinking... Surely there must be thermal drafts rising from these springs? If I was to float up on them, would they carry me off into the sky?"

dialogues.speaker: Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "Attention, dear guests from Mondstadt: Not only does drinking wine in the hot springs put you at risk of fainting, but if you spill any while bathing, you'll be fined! So whatever you do, don't drink and bathe!"

dialogues.speaker: Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "Golden Dusk not only offers an exquisite dining experience, but a wide variety of drinks too — so please save all wine-tasting for the restaurant!"

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "According to traditional medical wisdom, hot springs can help stimulate circulation and have a wide range of other outstanding health benefits. Just remember to be mindful of your diet and other factors if you plan to stay in the water for an extended time."

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "When you're spending time in the hot springs, it's important you find a balance by having some cool food and drinks. Otherwise, you might end up overheating yourself, which would defeat the whole purpose..."

dialogues.speaker: Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "Dear visitor, we greatly appreciate the recipe and introduction letter you've shared with us! We'll do our best to import the corresponding ingredients from Liyue to help the local restaurants enhance their menus!"

dialogues.speaker: Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "Additionally, your suggestion for us to open a medicinal herb hot spring has been noted for further discussion. Watch this space!"

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Ahhh, there really is nothing like a natural hot spring!"

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "The tingly wingly sensation of a steady stream of bubbles against your body — it defies description!"

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "It would be ideal if we could put up some more signs showing the exact temperatures of each hot spring, so guests could choose the ones that suit them best..."

dialogues.speaker: Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "Dear visitor, many thanks for your valuable suggestion. In line with our usual practice, we will first observe how the Koholasaur youngsters react before deciding if the water temperature is suitable for our foreign visitors."

dialogues.speaker: Manager's Reply
dialogues.text: "Thanks to your suggestion, we'll make it our aim to ensure that a little Koholasaur is stationed in each hot spring in the future!"

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Um, so basically... I just arrived from Fontaine, and my guide keeps recommending the hot springs here. I'm curious — what does everyone actually think of them?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Praise be to the God of Wisdom, I can't get enough of these hot springs! It feels like I'm melting into the pool..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Finally, a place where you don't have to be constantly on the lookout for dangerous Fungi... If only we could stumble upon hot springs like this while out on recon jobs in the rainforest!"

dialogues.speaker: Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Eh!? M—Melting? You mean like... dissolving in the water? That sounds... pretty dangerous..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Haha... Melting, shmelting, whatever you wanna call it. Honestly though, the moment I'm in there, it's like I've forgotten all my cares, all my worries, all my... responsibilities... Although, when I put like that, it does sound quite dangerous indeed..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "Anyway, we're already here, so why worry about all that? Just forget it all and let yourself melt into the hot spring... That's what vacations are all about."

dialogues.speaker: Another Visitor's Message
dialogues.text: "I found a great outdoor hot spring a few days ago that will LITERALLY melt you away. Fancy checking it out together tomorrow night?"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "I'm looking for a visitor from Fontaine who was asking about hot springs on the Visitors' Message Board — the one who mentioned something about 'melting,' or 'dissolving.'"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "I originally invited him to join me on a trip to an outdoor hot spring via this message board, but he never responded, and I'm worried he's gone missing. If anyone has any information about what might have happened to him, I would greatly appreciate it if you could let me know."

dialogues.speaker: Message From a Local
dialogues.text: "I've met him — I served as his guide a couple of days back. It seems like he's already set off back to Fontaine."

dialogues.speaker: Searcher's Response
dialogues.text: "Huh, gone already? And in such a hurry too... Did he mention... why?"

dialogues.speaker: Message From a Local
dialogues.text: "I think he might have been startled by something. He left in such a hurry, muttering something about 'dissolving'... Such a shame, especially given how few holidays they get..."
